body.x: Jiro Inc. (co-CEOs Jae Suk Jason Lee and Gilhwan Hwang) participated in CES Unveiled on January 5 (local time) before the official opening of CES 2025. Founded in 2020, the company is committed to providing faster, more streamlined video production solutions. It operates Dudum, Korea’s largest video production matching platform, and Dropshot Stock, an Asia-focused video stock library.

Within three years of its founding, Jiro secured a cumulative investment of 2 billion KRW and established partnerships with global corporations like Google, Hyundai Motor, Naver, and Doosan. Additionally, it has enhanced its service capabilities with offerings like Dudum All-in-One, tailored for startups, to optimize video production efficiency.

Jiro’s latest innovation, the AI-powered stock video pipeline app Dropshot Explorer, earned dual honors at CES 2025, winning Innovation Awards in the Content & Entertainment and Imaging categories. The app attracted significant attention at CES Unveiled for its ability to automatically extract relevant keywords from video content and process them into copyright-compliant stock video data.

body.cap: Jae Suk Jason Lee, Jiro’s Co-CEO, introduces Dropshot Explorer to AVING News reporter Alex Sigrist during CES 2025 Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: High-quality video content production often requires meticulous effort, and video clips captured during shoots are frequently discarded due to copyright issues. Jiro developed Dropshot Explorer to enable video production companies to transform unused footage into monetizable stock videos.

Jiro has also launched the Dropshot Stock service, allowing repurposed and refined video clips to be sold as stock footage, further expanding its customer base. Meanwhile, its Dudum platform, with over 970 partner companies, continues to explore collaborations with domestic broadcasters and international video influencers, aggressively expanding stock content categories such as landscapes, food, and people from Korea.

Jae Suk Jason Lee, Co-CEO of Jiro, stated, “As demand for high-quality video content surges across industries, particularly for Asian-focused visuals, the value of such video data is steadily rising. We aim to bring innovation to the global content market through technology and services that address these market trends.”

Lee added, “In an industry that has long been stagnant, attempting a paradigm shift and proving our innovation and competitiveness on the global stage at CES is deeply gratifying. We aim to create an environment where all video content creators, from production companies to individual influencers, can work easily and enjoyably.”

body.cap: Jae Suk Jason Lee presents Dropshot Explorer to international media representatives at CES Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Jiro Inc. participated in CES 2025 as part of the Seoul Pavilion in Eureka Park, the startup-focused exhibition area. The Seoul Pavilion, expanded by over 50% from the previous year to 1,040 square meters, featured 104 startups. It represents a collaboration between three Seoul districts (Gangnam, Geumcheon, and Gwanak), five startup support organizations (SBA, Seoul Tourism Organization, Seoul Bio Hub, Seoul AI Hub, and Campus Town Growth Center), and eight universities (Konkuk, Kyung Hee, Kookmin, Dongguk, Sogang, Seoul National University of Science and Technology, Yonsei, and Chung-Ang).
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
